label: Zoom meeting

login.message: Sign in to enter the meeting.
login.registerMessage: The meeting is reserved for registered participants. Register, or sign in if you already are.

register.message: The meeting is reserved for registered participants.
register.dayMessage: The day's live stream is reserved for those registered. One registration covers the whole day.
register.ended: This activity is over: registration is closed.

ready: Join from this page, no Zoom installation needed. If the meeting has not started, Zoom will ask you to wait.

step.waiting: Zoom is preparing your place in the meeting…

waitlisted: You are on the waiting list: entry is first come, first served, while places last.

error.sdk: Connecting to Zoom failed. Try again, or open the meeting in the Zoom app.
error.sdkReason: Connecting to Zoom failed ({reason}). Try again, or open the meeting in the Zoom app.

failure.title: The meeting video did not connect.
failure.stuck: The connection still fails. Check your network and try again, or open the meeting in the Zoom app.
